rows.grounds: locative of ayana indicating a temporal occasion
locative of viṣuva indicating a temporal occasion
locative of compound ṣaḍaśīti-mukha naming a specific sacred juncture
vocative address to the recipient of instruction

items.question: Which sacred temporal junctures are designated as occasions for the beloved's prescribed observance?
premises: The solstice is named as a designated occasion.
The equinox is named as a designated occasion.
The ṣaḍaśīti-mukha juncture is also named as a designated occasion.
items.inference: These specified temporal junctures are affirmed as appropriate occasions for the observance addressed to the beloved.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or astronomical referent of ṣaḍaśīti-mukha is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: At the solstice, at the equinox, and indeed at the ṣaḍaśīti-mukha, O beloved.
